remarks: Very nice spacious and bright 2nd floor two bedroom unit with one assigned parking spot plus street parking. Freshly painted, all new electric , new hardwood floors and carpet. New kitchen appliances are a bonus as well as new and redone white cabinets. There are some new tile floors in the kitchen as well. This unit has a spare room that could be used as a 3rd bedroom. There is a walk up attic which is great for storage. Convenient location close to I-95, downtown Stamford, the train station and Chelsea Piers. Walking distance to Cove Island beach is a plus as well.
